verdict.rationale: Mixpanel is an analytics platform with agents, an MCP server, and feature-flag rollouts, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack shows no version history, review or approval workflow, or rollback for automations, agents, or MCP-created assets. The feature-flag "rollout" item concerns releasing product variants, not reverting automation changes, so it does not count toward this story.
